ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/light gray) punctate distribution across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-toned field characterized by a stochastic distribution of high-contrast white speckles; higher density of light-intensity pixels is observed near the distal tips and along the mid-region of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 50-60 degrees; notch depth is distinct and divides the fluke into two symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge, creating a jagged silhouette against the background; serrations appear more pronounced at the outer distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips; the trajectory maintains a consistent upward and outward slope with slight tapering at the terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized clusters of high-contrast white circular spots distributed across both lobes, consistent with individual and grouped scar signatures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white punctate scarring across the ventral surface of both fluke lobes; no evidence of trailing edge amputations or major structural trauma visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density speckling pattern concentrated on the posterior half of the fluke lobes.
